listing.name: Pokémon Stadium / SS Anne / PokemonStadiumRecomp
listing.summary: Register your already working SS Anne Pokémon Stadium US v1.0 player. Upstream setup, runtime replacement and all game and Transfer Pak data remain yours.

steps.title: Keep the exact originals and complete data
steps.instruction: Use your own Pokémon Stadium US v1.0 original: canonical big-endian .z64 is 33554432 bytes, MD5 ed1378bc12115f71209a77844965ba50. Upstream also documents .n64/.v64 input; Rev A/v1.1 is incompatible. Optional Game Boy/Color Transfer Pak games and saves are separate user-owned inputs. No originals or cartridge data are supplied by Portcove.

steps.title: Choose a working upstream Windows folder
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted, working Windows x64 upstream-prepared v0.4.7-beta folder with PokemonStadiumRecomp.exe, all DLLs, assets and packaged GPL/component notices. This route registers an existing prepared folder; Portcove does not acquire or extract this package. Keep any archive or operating-system trust refusal in force; do not change protection settings to make the runtime pass. Select the actual PokemonStadiumRecomp.exe and its containing folder as working directory, then use its integrated SS Anne setup/PLAY screen. Keep all companions rather than selecting a helper or an isolated EXE.

steps.title: Preserve runtime and separate cartridge coordinates
steps.instruction: Preserve the complete executable/working folder: rom.cfg, launcher.cfg, the registered configuration/FlashRAM store, actual logs/crash reports and all other created files. launcher.cfg p1_rom/p1_save through p4_rom/p4_save resolve relative to the executable folder or as absolute paths. PSR_TRANSFER_PAK_P1_ROM/SAVE through P4 override them. Transfer Pak and GB Tower can write these separate cartridge saves during Play; keep complete original/safe writable copies, configured paths, creating runtimes and saves together. Registration/removal does not adopt, copy, migrate or delete these files; no save/state compatibility or managed backup is promised.

steps.title: Review upstream limits before explicit Play
steps.instruction: Maintenance has ceased; known bugs and incomplete cup/Gym Leader Castle coverage remain. The tagged source keeps its SS Anne launcher and game in the player process, and starts unauthenticated loopback debug control at 127.0.0.1:4371, including input/memory mutation and quit; PSR_DEBUG_PORT changes the valid port rather than disabling it. No network/debug isolation is claimed. User-selected trust requires your explicit review and consent. Upstream/user own preparation and replacement; preserve complete actual runtime/data first. Core offers registration, explicit supervised Play and reviewed registration-only removal; managed Install/Update/Backup/Rollback/migration/external deletion remain unavailable.

warnings: This route only registers a permitted, already working external player. Core does not acquire or extract the selected archive, authenticate the original, or provide managed maintenance or save/state compatibility.

The inspected tagged source starts unauthenticated loopback debug control. Transfer Pak and GB Tower can write separately configured cartridge saves; preserve the actual paths and creating runtimes. No actual game or Transfer Pak execution has been qualified.
